title: NetworkLoadBalancersPost
description: NetworkLoadBalancersPost represents the fields of a new LXD network load balancer

config.description: Load balancer configuration map (refer to doc/network-load-balancers.md)

description.description: Description of the load balancer listen IP

listen_address.description: The listen address of the load balancer

NetworkLoadBalancerBackend.description: NetworkLoadBalancerBackend represents a target backend specification in a network load balancer

description.description: Description of the load balancer backend

name.description: Name of the load balancer backend

target_port.description: TargetPort(s) to forward ListenPorts to (allows for many-to-one)

NetworkLoadBalancerPort.description: NetworkLoadBalancerPort represents a port specification in a network load balancer

description.description: Description of the load balancer port

listen_port.description: ListenPort(s) of load balancer (comma delimited ranges)

protocol.description: Protocol for load balancer port (either tcp or udp)

target_backend.description: TargetBackend specifies backend names to load balance ListenPorts to

target_pool.description: TargetPool specifies a pool to load balance ListenPorts to
